row.body: The bakery bundle is tied to a household note asking the parents to stay inside until the next pickup. The driver marked the first delivery complete.
row.title: The second delivery

sidecar.gloss: A completed delivery is followed by a second pickup request.
sidecar.rival_reading: A field crew could have left food and a stay-inside request at a work stop; the receipt does not identify who was meant to collect it.
